quests.textToSpeak: They toured the campus, met the professors, and applied the same week.
options: The natural pause falls right after 'met' instead, splitting the sentence at that point.
The natural pause falls right after 'campus', separating one complete phrase from the next.
quests.correctAnswer: The natural pause falls right after 'campus', separating one complete phrase from the next.
quests.ipa: /ðeɪ tʊəd ðə ˈkæmpəs | met ðə prəˈfesəz | ən əˈplaɪd ðə seɪm wiːk/
quests.hint: Try reading both options aloud. One will feel like a natural breath group; the other will feel like it cuts a phrase in half.
quests.explanation: Because 'campus' completes a full grammatical unit, that's where the pause naturally falls, rather than the mid-phrase break at 'met'.
